newsitem.title: USA: Detroit Diesel sees lower than expected Q4.
newsitem.headline: Detroit Diesel sees lower than expected Q4.

text.p: Detroit Diesel Corp said Monday it expects fourth quarter earnings of $0.17 to $0.20 a share, below the current consensus of analysts' estimates for the quarter of $0.32 a share.

Detroit Diesel said its results were hurt by costs associated with the relocation and consolidation of its remanufacturing businesses and higher than expected market support for its heavy-duty engine business.
In the 1995 fourth quarter, Detroit Diesel earned $0.46 a share before a restructuring charge and $0.18 a share after the charge.
Detroit Diesel said it expects to release results for the fourth quarter and full year 1996 on February 5.
Detroit Diesel makes, sells and services heavy-duty diesel and alternative fuel engines, automotive diesel engines and related products.
